title: Self-Improving Agents with World Model Predictive Paths
abstract: arXiv:2610.28945v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly expected to interact with environments and improve their decisions during deployment. However, how anticipating future outcomes and drawing on accumulated interaction experience can jointly support decision-making remains underexplored. We propose a test-time framework, inspired by Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) control, that combines multi-branch predictive analysis with experience-based adaptation. At each step, the agent proposes multiple candidate actions and imagines their outcomes with a world model, so that alternatives can be compared without being executed in the environment. Since language environments provide neither explicit dynamics nor costs, the predicted outcomes are evaluated for task progress and risk, and MPPI-style weights over the resulting costs guide the final decision. translated_title: 基于世界模型预测路径的自我改进智能体
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越被期望能够与环境交互并在部署过程中改进其决策。然而，如何通过预判未来结果并利用积累的交互经验来共同支持决策制定，仍然缺乏充分探索。我们提出了一种受模型预测路径积分（MPPI）控制启发的测试时框架，该框架将多分支预测分析与基于经验的适应相结合。在每一步中，智能体提出多个候选动作，并利用世界模型想象这些动作的结果，从而无需在环境中实际执行即可比较不同方案。由于语言环境既不提供显式的动力学模型也不提供显式的成本函数，因此对预测结果进行任务进度和风险两方面的评估，并采用MPPI风格的权重对由此产生的成本进行加权，以指导最终决策。双分支经验记忆实现了自我改进：规划器分支对候选动作进行细化……
tldr: 提出一种受MPPI控制启发的测试时框架，通过世界模型对多个候选动作的结果进行预测评估，并结合双分支经验记忆，实现LLM智能体在部署过程中的自我改进决策。
en_tdlr: A test-time framework inspired by MPPI control that uses a world model to predict and evaluate multiple candidate actions, combined with dual-branch experience memory, enabling self-improving decision-making for LLM agents during deployment.
